topic: What would happen if oxygen levels doubled?

scenario.title: Oxygen DOUBLED? The World Ignites... And So Do YOU!
scenario.clickbait_title: Oxygen DOUBLED? The World Ignites... And So Do YOU!
scenario.thumbnail_concept: A dramatic vertical shot of a city street engulfed in impossible, vibrant orange flames, with a person in the foreground shielding their face, looking terrified. High contrast, cinematic lighting, 8K detail.
scenario.seo_description: What if oxygen levels on Earth suddenly doubled? Roli the rabbit scientist reveals the terrifying truth. From uncontrollable fires to your body turning against itself, discover why more oxygen isn't always better in this mind-blowing scientific scenario.

scenes.narration: FLAMES erupt everywhere. Your backyard trees explode. Even damp grass ignites. Your lungs burn, hyper-oxygenated. Every spark is now a catastrophe. Nowhere is safe.
scenes.visual_prompt: A highly cinematic, vertical 9:16 shot of a massive, impossibly bright inferno engulfing a suburban street. Fire consumes houses and cars in a terrifying, fast-moving wave. Smoke billows dark against a molten orange sky. Extreme high contrast, photorealistic, 8K detail, dramatic atmosphere, wide-angle lens showing destruction.
scenes.twist_element: The omnipresent, immediate threat of fire and the unexplained burning sensation in the viewer's lungs.

scenes.narration: But that's just the start. Insects grow monstrous, gorging on the enriched air. Spiders the size of cats hunt freely. Roli warns: Your own heart races, pushing too hard. It's too much.
scenes.visual_prompt: A vertical 9:16 shot showing Roli, the time-traveling rabbit scientist in steampunk goggles and a lab coat, looking alarmed and pointing a mechanical device towards a colossal, hairy spider (cat-sized) scuttling across a charred, overgrown urban ruin. Cinematic lighting, dramatic shadows, photorealistic, 8K detail. Focus on Roli's frantic gesture and the spider's menacing presence.
scenes.twist_element: The biological escalation of monstrous insects and the alarming internal physical sensation of your heart racing.

scenes.narration: Actually, the initial euphoria quickly turns toxic. Your cells overload, free radicals ravaging everything. Your brain misfires. Your body attacks itself. You collapse. The world burns as your breath betrays you, erupting in FLAMES.
scenes.visual_prompt: A vertical 9:16 shot of a human figure collapsing to their knees on a smoky, cracked street. Their face is contorted in pain and confusion, eyes wide. In the background, the sky glows with an eerie, orange firelight, hinting at ongoing destruction. Cinematic lighting, photorealistic, 8K detail, dramatic and urgent atmosphere, emphasizing human vulnerability.
scenes.twist_element: The ultimate betrayal by your own body due to hyperoxia, looping back to the initial image of fire.
